title: NASA Made Atoms 10 Billion Times Colder Than Nature
hook: NASA made atoms 10 billion times colder than nature's record.
closing: Human-made cold opens experiments the nearby universe cannot provide.
question: What could ultracold atoms reveal?

segments.say: Deep space sits at 2.7 kelvin. Even emptiness cannot match the coldest natural place shown.
NASA's Cold Atom Lab reached 0.0000000001 kelvin. Humans pushed matter beyond nature's coldest known setting.
The cold experiment is only 250 miles overhead. Unreachable natural cold became nearby science.
